acceptance: The original protected two-atom cutoff query aborts the old backend with an 8,000,000,000-byte head allocation and succeeds after correction; no unconstrained OOM test is used.

One numerical budget accounts for selected numeric blocks, retained grids, controlled scratch, row descriptors and observed CSR hits; atomic admission precedes row output. Sparse results are not refused by a quadratic worst-case pair estimate.

The contact consumer reserves its Boolean map before native admission, defers allocation until admission and fills with one occurrence-index array. Empty periodic structure selections retain typed CSR offsets without indexing box row zero.

limits: The numerical allowance is an estimate, not process RSS or reserved host memory; source domains, preparation, allocator/engine costs and legacy Python compatibility representations have separate costs. #693 owns representation accounting.
